title: LockDependency
description: One resolved entry in rusl.lock, keyed by package key (schema:account/schemas/slug or bundle:account/bundles/slug). Records the exact version, content integrity, and origin of a resolved resource so installs are reproducible.

version.description: Exact semantic version chosen by the resolver. An unpublished dev schema resolved from its local file records the placeholder 0.0.0.

integrity.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the downloaded schema content. Empty for bundles and for dev schemas resolved from the local file.

source.description: Where the resource was resolved from: the registry API base URL, or the reserved value "local" for a dev schema that has no published versions and was resolved from its on-disk file.

dependencies.description: Package keys of the direct dependencies of this resource at the resolved version. Omitted when empty.
